will provide U.S. government agencies with free access to its ChatGPT licenses and 50% discounts on usage costs.
The AI company said Thursday it has reached an agreement with the U.S. General Services Administration that will run for 27 months, from Oct. 1 through Dec. 31, 2028.
The offer will be available to federal, state, local, and tribal governments.
OpenAI said the agreement removes its standard $15-per-user monthly license fee, with no minimum spending requirement.
It will also provide training and other support for government employees, including cybersecurity workers.
The company said more than 1M government employees already have access to ChatGPT through existing agreements.

"Public servants should help shape how AI is used in government, and that starts by giving them access to best-in-class tools, including GPT‑6 Astra, with strong safeguards, cost predictability and respect for their public mission," the company said.

title: OpenAI offers free ChatGPT licenses, 50% usage discount to U.S. governments
